reason: A chat-interface media utility that saves pasted images locally, adds their absolute paths to outgoing messages, and provides preview access to saved files.

summaries.zh: 在会话输入框粘贴图片时自动保存到配置目录，并将图片绝对路径添加到消息中供后续识别。
summaries.en: Automatically saves images pasted into the chat composer to a configured directory and adds their absolute paths to messages for subsequent processing.

capabilities: Intercepts image pastes in the chat composer
Saves pasted images to a user-configured directory
Appends saved image absolute paths to message drafts
Serves saved images for preview through a plugin route
Provides configuration and save API endpoints
